risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (360.8), flat yield curve signaling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinational earnings, with earnings event in 42 days adding execution risk.

debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below both EMA-50 and SMA-200 with overbought oscillators, no active strategy triggers, high earnings risk in 42 days, zero smart money conviction, and severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, rising dollar, flat yield curve) make this a false signal in deteriorating environment.
